top_news.title: Hedge Funds Turn Most Negative on the Japanese Yen Since 2007
top_news.summary: Hedge funds turned the most negative on the yen since 2007 as the currency trades near its weakest level in four decades.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks Set to Gain After Tech-Powered Rally: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Stocks in Asia are poised to edge higher after a rally in several US technology giants revived confidence that the AI-driven bull market still has room to run.

top_news.title: Hamilton Lane Raises $3.8 Billion Fund Targeting Mid-Market Private Equity Deals
top_news.summary: Erik Hirsch, Co-CEO at Hamilton Lane, discussed the firm's recent $3.8 billion fundraise aimed at co-investing alongside private equity in mid-market companies. Hirsch emphasized the focus on smaller and mid-sized firms that are typically too small to pursue public offerings, highlighting that significant returns in private markets often come from these less visible segments. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Katie Greifeld on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Lone Pine Gains 43% in First Half on Long and Short Bets
top_news.summary: Lone Pine Capital posted a 43% gain for its hedge fund investors through June, notching one of its best-ever starts to a year and landing it among 2026’s top performers.

top_news.title: Test Your ETF Knowledge In Our IQ Test
top_news.summary: Bloomberg's Joel Weber puts Scarlet Fu, Katie Greifeld, and Eric Balchunas to the test on "Bloomberg ETF IQ" in this week's edition of "IQ Test." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Tech Stocks Extend Rally Ahead of Samsung Earnings, SK Hynix IPO
top_news.summary: US stocks climbed on Monday as investors jumped on technology shares after the blistering artificial-intelligence trade wavered heading into the holiday weekend.

top_news.title: How to Get the Most Out of Your Kid’s Trump Account
top_news.summary: Families with young kids can officially start putting money in a Trump Account as of July 4, 2026. But is this account right for you and your kid's savings goals and needs? Sarah Foster explains  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Stocks Push Higher Led by Chipmakers | Closing Bell

top_news.title: Tech Giants Drive Stock Gains in AI Trade Revival: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: A rally in several technology giants lifted stocks amid speculation that the artificial-intelligence trade that has powered the bull market has more room to run.

top_news.title: Traders Are Most Positive on Dollar Since 2015 as Fed Hike Looms
top_news.summary: Global traders have turned the most positive on the outlook for the dollar since 2015 as bets that borrowing costs will remain elevated for longer have fueled a monthlong rally in the US currency.
